To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the dynamic range and reproducibility are similar for three different microarray platforms; 2) the sensitivity is different for the three platforms, and 3) the platforms fail to consistently identify the genes that are differentially expressed between samples, even though the same samples were used in all cases.
the three microarray platforms that we tested are highly reproducible, but they fail to consistently identify the exact same genes as different between samples.

different microarray platforms report different results, and that these differences are not random, but systematic.
